investigation_notes.Description: The Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on an editorial article page hosted at themedicalbulletin.org, with header and in-content imagery that contextually reference the company. The domain has a long registration history (12 years) and resolves through Cloudflare CDN with an abuse confidence score of 0, and no recent similar alerts were found, all of which support a legitimate hosting context. The page layout appears editorial with no visible credential collection forms or deceptive UX elements, and the visual logo usage is consistent with legitimate brand placement. Based on the domain age, infrastructure reputation, page context, and lack of prior malicious activity, this detection is assessed as Low Priority.
